== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Shawn Valdez (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Shawn Valdez (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]. Lower part of the disc card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>91593ef23d13e98db498eb155fd24f768db9b9b0</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
